Noted on the minds 0.4.0 wire-compat snapshot that it also covers the minds 0.4.2 release, and extended its `SUPPORT_ENDS` to 2026-09-24 (0.4.2's release date plus the support window). The strictly-parsed connector response surface is unchanged between minds-v0.4.1 and minds-v0.4.2: the only `wire_types` changes are docstrings, field descriptions, and the additive operator-only `AdminAccountInfo`, which no strictly-parsed endpoint maps to. No new snapshot module is needed, and nothing was pruned.
